MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

3. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.

4. When learning Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.

5. When learning Live streaming Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Live streaming Project.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Live streaming Project.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Live streaming Project.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Live streaming Project.

6. When learning Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

8. When learning Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   B. Skip safety briefings for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

10. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.

11. When learning Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.

12. When learning Pre- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre- production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Pre- production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre- production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre- production.

13. When learning Photography: technology and techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography: technology and techniques.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography: technology and techniques.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Photography: technology and techniques.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography: technology and techniques.

14. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

15. When learning Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.

16. When learning Fundamentals of Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
